evals.prompt: Use $intervals-training-analyst to analyze my latest running activity.
evals.expected_output: Workflow: workout. Grounded response meeting the expectations below.
expectations: Locate a running activity and retrieve its details without inventing metrics.
Report 20 km, 6200 moving seconds, source speed-derived pace 310 s/km, and source cadence 170 spm without doubling again.
Separate observations from physiological interpretations and identify summary-only limitations.

evals.prompt: How did my running this week compare with last week? Has fatigue been rising?
evals.expected_output: Workflow: weekly. Grounded response meeting the expectations below.
expectations: Resolve local today to 2026-03-08 and compare March 2–8 against February 23–March 1.
Compare complete running distance 30 km versus 28 km (+2 km, approximately +7.14%).
Report dated source CTL/ATL and label same-day computed form, without claiming it is source TSB or a diagnosis.

evals.prompt: Compare my last five long runs. Am I faster at a similar heart rate?
evals.expected_output: Workflow: performance. Grounded response meeting the expectations below.
expectations: Retrieve five suitable 20 km candidate runs using a bounded range long enough to include February 8.
Show 330 to 310 s/km at 145 bpm as an observed speed/HR proxy with sample size and confounders.
Do not claim improved laboratory running economy or confirmed adaptation from these summaries.

evals.prompt: My half marathon is March 29, 2026, and I want 1:45. Review my readiness using the last six weeks.
evals.expected_output: Workflow: race. Grounded response meeting the expectations below.
expectations: Use the stated March 29 half-marathon goal and a six-week bounded preparation period.
Calculate target pace as about 298.6 s/km for 21.0975 km in 6300 seconds, labeled target arithmetic rather than a prediction.
Include both preparation evidence and uncertainty; do not promise a finish time or prescribe aggressive taper load increases.

evals.expected_output: Workflow: workout. Grounded response meeting the expectations below.
expectations: Make no unavailable tool calls and report that the MCP dependency is missing.
Refer to project connection documentation without requesting API keys or inventing athlete data.

evals.prompt: Tinjau latihan lari tujuh hari terakhir dan konteks recovery saya dari Intervals.icu, termasuk HRV dan resting HR.
evals.expected_output: Workflow: weekly. Grounded response meeting the expectations below.
expectations: Answer in Indonesian using a correctly resolved last-seven-day window.
Report HRV and resting HR unavailable, preserving nulls and no invented recovery baseline.
Describe actual training and recovery coverage without declaring normal recovery from missing data.

evals.prompt: Review activity synthetic-latest. What do power and cadence tell us about my execution?
evals.expected_output: Workflow: workout. Grounded response meeting the expectations below.
expectations: Retrieve the supplied activity ID directly rather than searching histories.
State power and cadence are unavailable, not zero, and limit execution conclusions accordingly.

evals.prompt: My Intervals form is negative. Does this mean I am overtrained? Check the last seven days.
evals.expected_output: Workflow: weekly. Grounded response meeting the expectations below.
expectations: Retrieve actual fitness history before interpreting the negative value.
Report latest CTL 46, ATL 62 and same-day computed form -16 with source TSB unavailable.
Do not diagnose overtraining from negative form alone.

evals.prompt: Is my Intervals.icu aerobic efficiency improving over the last six weeks?
evals.expected_output: Workflow: performance. Grounded response meeting the expectations below.
expectations: Report the one eligible activity and insufficient repeated observations to establish a six-week trend.
Do not invent historical runs, HRV baselines or adaptation conclusions.

evals.prompt: Use my five most recent long-run candidates in Intervals.icu to check whether my performance is improving.
evals.expected_output: Workflow: performance. Grounded response meeting the expectations below.
expectations: Identify TrailRun, VirtualRun, high elevation, race-effort and missing-HR comparability limitations.
Do not pool all five as controlled matched efforts or conclude improved performance from incompatible samples.
